description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build autonomous AI agents designed to perform complex computer-based work reliably over extended periods. You will own core agent systems, from execution and memory to evaluation, helping advance agents from human-reviewed runs toward dependable autonomous operation.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build agents that can work toward a goal over multiple weeks with minimal or no human intervention.

 - Design memory systems that help agents retain knowledge and improve as they work.

 - Develop evaluation frameworks to determine whether agents outperform human task baselines.

 - Improve agent reliability and reduce the need for human review of each run.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Hands-on experience building production agents that people rely on, with a clear understanding of their failure modes.

 - Experience building agent memory, long-running execution, or multi-step reasoning systems that maintain goals over time.

 - Experience creating evaluation frameworks that inform real decisions and measure performance against human-level baselines.

 - At least 1 to 2 years of experience at a fast-growing or AI-focused startup.

 - A record of either publishing research that others build on or shipping software at meaningful scale.

 - Strong engineering fundamentals; experience designing agent architectures is a plus.

 - Background in competitive math, programming, debate, games, founding, or an equivalent high-achievement path is valued.

 - Collaborative approach and conviction in the potential of AI agents.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

$200,000 to $300,000 annual base salary, with up to $350,000 for exceptional candidates. Meaningful founding equity is offered. Visa sponsorship is available.


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, California, five days per week.
